THE CHINA PRESS, FRIDAY, MARCH 5, 1937S.

Marquis Li
Pleads Poverty
In Court Here

Tells Judge He Has No
Money; Unable To
Pay Debts

Marquis Li Kuo-chieh, deposed
General Manager of China Mer-
chants' Steam Navigation Company,
who was convicted of malfeasance
of duty and misappropriation se-
veral years ago, pleaded poverty
before Judge Wang at the Shang-
hai District Court in Nantao Wed-
nesday afternoon during the
hearing of a civil case in which
he is the defendant.

The marquis told the judge that
after the inheritance of the Li
family was divided among the four
brothers (including himself), he
has engaged in business enterprises
which all went bankrupt. As a
result, he has no money nor pro-
perty, he added.

The court session opened Wed-
nesday afternoon with a report
given by Mr. Chiang Ho-chun,
counsel for the Ministry of Com-
munications. Mr. Chiang told the
court that it was first discovered
that the defendant owns the Mao
Lu Experimental Farm at Chin
Tan Hsien but inquiries made with
authorities of that hsien revealed
that said property does not now be-
long to Marquis Li.

Referring to the report that
Marquis Li obtained a loan of $30,-
000 from the Ningpo Commercial
and Savings Bank on the mortgages
of bonds of the Chang Hwa Iron
Works in Fan Chang Hsien, Anhwei
Province on November 25, 1935,
Messrs. Chu Jen and Shih Nai-hsu,
representing the bank concerned,
told the court that the name given
in the application for the loan was
Li Wei-hou and that the mortgages
presented for it also included a
watch with precious stones made
in England in addition to $50,000
worth of bonds of the works in
Anhwei.

Messrs. Chu and Shih further
told the court that the value of
bonds offered for mortgage on the
loan in 1935 are now worth only
$5,000. The two lawyers asked that
the bank should be allowed the
priority of payment in redemption
of the loan by the defendant. In
reply, Judge Wang instructed that
the bank should first submit to the
court a list of the properties mort-
gaged by the defendant and then
proceed with the suit for redemp-
tion of the loan.

Mr. Chiang, counsel for plaintiff,
asked the court to remand the case
to enable him to consult the China
Merchants' Steam Navigation Com-
pany and through that company,
the Ministry of Communications as
to the disposal of the case.

李侯爵
在法庭上哭穷

告诉法官他身无分文；无力偿还债务

招商局轮船公司前总经理李国杰侯爵，数年前曾因渎职和挪用公款被判有罪，周三下午在南市上海地方法院审理其作为被告的一起民事案件时，向王法官哭穷。

这位侯爵告诉法官，李家遗产在四兄弟（包括他自己）之间分割后，他从事的商业企业均告破产。因此，他既无金钱也无财产，他补充道。

庭审于周三下午开始，首先由交通部律师江浩钧先生作报告。江先生告诉法庭，起初发现被告在金坛县拥有毛陆实验农场，但经向该县当局查询，显示该财产目前不属于李侯爵。

提及有关李侯爵于1935年11月25日以安徽省繁昌县昌华铁厂债券为抵押，从宁波商业储蓄银行获得3万美元贷款的报告，代表相关银行的朱仁先生和施乃旭先生告诉法庭，贷款申请中使用的名字是李维厚，为此提交的抵押品除了价值5万美元的安徽铁厂债券外，还包括一块英国制造的镶宝石手表。

朱先生和施先生进一步告诉法庭，1935年用于贷款抵押的债券现在仅值5,000美元。两位律师请求允许该银行在被告偿还贷款时享有优先受偿权。作为回应，王法官指示银行应先向法院提交被告抵押财产的清单，然后再进行贷款追偿诉讼。

原告律师江先生请求法院将案件发回，以便他就案件的处理事宜咨询招商局轮船公司，并通过该公司咨询交通部。

MARQUIS LI'S ASSETS
BEING SOUGHT

Nantao Court Seeking
To Obtain Money In
Bribery Case

An order has been issued by the
Nantao District Court to Marquis
Li Kuo-chich, former general mana-
ger of China Merchants' Steam
Navigation Company, requiring him
to hand over his share in the com-
pany amounting to $50,000 which
he mortgaged some years ago to the
Ningpo Commercial and Savings
Bank for $30,000. In issuing the
order the court wishes to enable
the marquis to return the $700,000.
plus interest, which he paid to a
former government superintendent
of the company in exchange for the
latter's permission to mortgage
wharf properties of the company to
a foreign firm.

The Marquis was formerly sen-
tenced to prison terms for bribery,
but upon acquittal, which he secur-
ed after fighting a long legal bat-
tle, he was ordered to return the
bribe plus interest, which amounts
to nearly $1,200,000. The Marquis
has repeatedly failed to pay the
installments as ordered by the
court. An official investigation has
been made in order to ascertain
the location of his properties which
might be auctioned to meet his
obligations, but so far it has not
been successful.

After returning to Shanghai from
a trip to Peiping Marquis Li was
to have appeared at a hearing held
on Friday, but he again failed to
do so on plea of illness. His lawyers
told the court that he had the $50,-
000 bonds mortgaged to the above-
mentioned bank and the court
promptly acted on it. Besides this,
his lawyers said, he had no proper-
ty in Shanghai.

A lawyer for the company, or
plaintiffs, asserted that the Mar-
quis owned a farm in Chin Tan
Hsien but Marquise Li's lawyers
denied this. Both parties to the
dispute, however, were asked to
investigate the farm report. The
court also promised to write to the
Chin Tan District Government to
ascertain the ownership of the farm.

正在追查李侯爵的资产

南市法院试图在贿赂案中追回款项

南市地方法院已向招商局轮船公司前总经理李国杰侯爵发出命令，要求他交出其在公司的股份，该股份价值5万美元，他曾于数年前以此向宁波商业储蓄银行抵押贷款3万美元。法院发布此令，旨在使侯爵能够归还他支付给该公司前政府监理的70万美元及利息，以换取后者许可将公司码头财产抵押给一家外国公司。

李侯爵此前曾因贿赂罪被判入狱，但在经过长期的法律斗争并获得无罪释放后，他被责令退还贿赂款及利息，总额近120万美元。李侯爵多次未按法院命令支付分期款项。官方已进行调查，以确定其可能被拍卖以履行义务的财产所在地，但迄今尚未成功。

李侯爵从北平旅行返回上海后，原定于周五出席听证会，但他再次以生病为由未能出庭。他的律师告诉法庭，他已将价值5万美元的债券抵押给上述银行，法院随即对此采取了行动。此外，他的律师称，他在上海没有其他财产。

该公司或原告的律师声称，李侯爵在金坛县拥有一座农场，但李侯爵的律师予以否认。然而，争议双方均被要求调查有关农场的报告。法院还承诺致函金坛区政府，以查明该农场的所有权。

NEW DEPARTMENT IN
CHINA MERCHANTS

All Ocean Shipping To
Be Handled Through
Firm's Agents

An Ocean Shipping Department
of the China Merchants S.N. Co.,
Ltd. has been established at 133,
Yuen Ming Yuen Road to handle all
ocean transportation of cargoes and
their transhipment, to and from
China. Agents representing the
Company have been appointed in
all important shipping centres of
the world, it is learned.

In order to acquaint the shipping
world of this move on the part of
the China Merchants, a meeting of
various lines and shipping brokers
interested in ocean transportation
between Europe and China was held
at the office of its Ocean Shipping
Department at the above address
yesterday. The meeting was presid-
ed over by Mr. T. K. King, Manager
of the Shipping Department of the
China Merchants, who explained to
those present the steps to be taken
by the company in giving effect to
the Resolution of the Executive
Yuan dated July 3, which provided
that the China Merchant Steam
Navigation Co., Ltd. shall handle the
booking of all ocean freight space
for cargoes and merchandise pur-
chased by the National Government
and agencies thereof, whether Cen-
tral, Provisional, Municipal, civil or
military.

At the meeting, representatives of
interested lines were advised of the
agency set-up abroad and the re-
quirement of the China Merchants.
The meeting was mainly called to
acquaint the European lines on the
operations of the Ocean Shipping
Department, in order that they may
be able to inform their principals
and more closely co-operate in giv-
ing effect to the Executive Yuan's
resolution.

招商局设立新部门

所有远洋航运将通过公司代理处理

据悉，招商局轮船股份有限公司已在圆明园路133号设立远洋航运部，负责处理进出中国的所有货物远洋运输及转运事务。该公司已在世界各重要航运中心委派了代表公司的代理人。

为了让航运界了解招商局的这一举措，昨日在上述地址的远洋航运部办公室举行了一次会议，与会者包括对中欧间远洋运输感兴趣的各种轮船公司和航运经纪人。会议由招商局航运部经理金通吉先生主持，他向与会者解释了公司为执行行政院7月3日决议所采取的步骤，该决议规定，招商局轮船股份有限公司应负责办理国民政府及其所属中央、临时、市级、民用或军事机构购买的所有货物和商品的远洋货运舱位预订。

会上，有关轮船公司的代表获悉了海外代理机构的设置情况及招商局的要求。召开此次会议主要是为了让欧洲轮船公司了解远洋航运部的运作情况，以便它们能够告知其委托人，并在执行行政院决议方面进行更密切的合作。

As a result of the incessant reforms undertaken in the improvement of its services and the efforts at the expansion of its business, the China Merchants Steam Navigation Company has been able to report continued increases in its revenues for the last few months. Compared with showings for the corresponding months in 1935, the Company's receipts from passenger and freight for last July, August and September reveal increases of 11, 48 and 55 per cent. respectively. The revenue for October is $896,148.14, which exceeds the figure of $630,932.47 for the same month last year by 42 per cent. This increase is noteworthy in view of the difficulty of navigating in the Yangtze on account of the present low water season.

李侯爵被责令向公司支付120万美元

因李侯爵未从北平抵达，听证会再次休庭；招商局寻求处置李之财产

招商局轮船公司前总经理李国杰侯爵，曾被南市地方法院责令支付近120万美元，以赔偿公司因其向前任政府监理支付70.9万美元贿赂以换取后者许可抵押码头财产而遭受的损失，且迄今分文未付，昨天再次未出庭。

听证会原旨在处置侯爵财产以履行其义务，现推迟至被告从北平返回上海后再行举行。李侯爵近期以北平政府特派员身份前往北平，护送已故段祺瑞元帅灵柩至西山举行国葬。

称病 plea
李侯爵的律师尤金·江先生昨天告诉法庭，在上次听证会后，他立即通知了在北平的当事人，表示法院希望尽快结案。江先生说，侯爵回复称他生病了，无法返回上海参加听证会。

这家轮船公司的律师请求法院处置已为人所知的属于侯爵的财产，但江先生辩称侯爵没有财产。

经过长期的法律斗争，李侯爵约在六个月前获释出狱，但被责令退还贿赂款及利息，总额近120万美元。该公司已刊登广告征集线索，以揭示侯爵财产的下落，但显然未取得良好结果。公司与中华地产公司签署的码头抵押协议已于数年前被中国政府宣布无效。

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, SATURDAY, DECEMBER 19, 1931.

Properties Of Marquis Li In
Danger Of Being Sold

Nantao District Court To Make Decision Regarding
Disposal To Satisfy Judgment Over Disposal Of
China Merchants Wharf Property

An important hearing, executive in nature, is scheduled to be held on Tuesday, in the Nantao District Court, to dispose of the private properties of Marquis Li Kuo-chieb, former general manager of the China Merchants' Steam Navigation Company who has failed, so far, to pay about $1,200,000 to make good the loss sustained by the company as a result of his paying an alleged bribe of $700,000 to a former Government superintendent of the company in exchange for the latter's permission to mortgage wharf properties of the company.

The long legal battle in which the Marquis was the defendant was started more than two years ago after the Chinese government had declared the mortgage agreement null and void. Marquis Li was charged with several crimes in the court, including malfeasance in office, but after a long trial lasting several months he was sentenced to eight months' imprisonment. The sentence was suspended for two years but the Marquis was ordered to return monies now amounting to nearly $1,200,000.

Repeated warnings have been issued by the court to the Marquis that the payment must be made but so far Marquis Li has not paid a cent. The court permitted the payment to be made by instalments some months ago but still the Marquis failed to fulfill the obligation. The Company advertised for informants who could report on the location of the Marquis' properties, wishing to sell them in order to obtain cash to refund the alleged bribe money.

Released On Bonds

Marquis Li was released about half a year ago on personal guarantees supplied by two prominent Chinese, Messrs. Authorities of the shipping company grew impatient and asked the court to make an order of bankruptcy against the Marquis, who opposed the procedure.

The court asked the Marquis to disclose the location of his properties, but the Marquis refused. The situation was further aggravated recently when the Marquis left for Peiping being appointed by the Government to escort the late Marshal Tuan Chi-jui's casket to the former capital for a state burial. 周二将在南市地方法院举行一次重要的执行性质听证会，以处置前招商局轮船公司（China Merchants' Steam Navigation Company）总经理李国杰侯爵的私人财产。李国杰迄今未能支付约120万美元，以弥补公司因其向该公司前政府监督行贿70万美元以换取后者许可抵押公司码头财产而遭受的损失。

这场漫长的法律诉讼中，侯爵为被告，始于两年前中国政府宣布抵押协议无效之后。李侯爵在法庭上被指控犯有包括渎职在内的多项罪行，但经过长达数月的漫长审判，他被判处八个月监禁。刑期缓期两年执行，但法院命令李侯爵归还目前总额近120万美元的款项。

法院已多次向李侯爵发出警告，要求必须付款，但迄今为止，李侯爵分文未付。几个月前，法院允许分期付款，但李侯爵仍未履行义务。该公司刊登广告，征集能提供李侯爵财产线索的线人，希望变卖这些财产以获得现金，退还所谓的贿款。

约半年前，李侯爵由两位知名华人李士豪先生（冀察政务委员会经济委员会主任委员）和 Yu **〔此处转录不清〕** 先生提供个人担保后获释。轮船公司当局变得不耐烦，请求法院对李侯爵下达破产令，李侯爵对此程序表示反对。

法院要求李侯爵披露其财产所在地，但李侯爵拒绝。最近，李侯爵奉政府之命护送已故段祺瑞元帅灵柩前往旧都北平举行国葬，局势进一步恶化。如果李侯爵不出庭，预计法院将采取强硬行动。

'Cruiser' Amazed At
Changes In C.M.S.N.

New Spirit Permeates Staff Personnel; Significant
Gains Made In Company Finances; Waste
Avoided, Energy Saved

By CRUISER

Things happen right under our eyes some times and we can't
see it. As an old say has it: We can't see the forest because of
the trees.

How often in Shanghai hasn't a new building seemed to sprout
over night like a mushroom. Builders have a habit of hiding these
works of art behind bamboo fences and then suddenly stripping them of
their outer casing, leaving, so to speak, the bare elbow.

Now take the case of the China
Merchants Steam Navigation Com-
pany—C.M.S.N. for short. It did
not even have a bamboo fence up
when "they" transferred the offices
on the Bund and around the corner
on Pootow road. Perhaps that's
why we never suspected anything
was going on.

One day our curiosity was only
half aroused by the appearance
of a new revolving door at the
main entrance on the Bund. As
we were in a hurry on that parti-
cular day another opportunity to
investigate this phenomenon did
not present itself for several days.
Came the day when we had more
time to spare. We noticed some-
thing different about the outside
windows too. The cause, like
chess, once you immediately hold
suspicion and without any further
protestations, we stepped inside.

Amazed were we.

Old Men With Broken Noses

You see in the old days we were
inclined to view the China Mer-
chants office like a person with
a broken nose. It looked as if it
had seen all the battles of life
and everything in the world for
it seemed to have survived. In
fact we had a bet with us being
the manager's private secretary. He
was so busy doing nothing he
couldn't find time to do anything.

That was a long time ago. Now
everything seems to be humming
along. I went in to see Mr. King's
office. Agents, managers and businessmen
kept crowding in one after the other.
Clerks came hurrying in, hurrying
out with special orders. Telephones
buzzed, orders were given in snappy
tone. There was little argumenta-
tion, chewing of the fat. People
on the other end of the phone were
told to "Get this ship back with-
out further delay... no use keeping
her over there another day burn-
ing up coal." This was a sample
of the general conversation I over-
heard. There was action and
hubbub here but no confusion.

Backed up by such an able man-
ager of the Shipping Department
as Mr. T. K. King, General Man-
ager J. K. Choy has been working
wonders in the organization and
administration of the veteran and
popular Chinese shipping company.

Here's an example of what has
been done:

Monthly tonnage freight
and passengers increased to
$11,110.83 in September re-
presenting a gain of 15 per
cent over the same period last
year.

Increase of 11 per cent said
to have come in July and August
compared with the correspond-
ing months in 1935.

With the revival of efficiency
in the running of the ships and avoid-
ance of waste, the China Mer-
chants Steam Navigation Co. is now
making a profit. This represents a
great change from the past when
the company was losing money.

The management has also intro-
duced a new system of accounting
which has proved very effective.
This has enabled the company to
keep a closer check on its expendi-
ture and to eliminate unnecessary
costs.

The staff personnel has also been
revamped. Old men with broken
noses have been replaced by young
and energetic men who are eager
to learn and to work hard. This
has resulted in a great improvement
in the efficiency of the company.

The China Merchants Steam Nav-
igation Co. is now looking forward
to a bright future. With the new
spirit permeating the staff person-
nel and the significant gains made
in the company finances, there is
no doubt that the company will
continue to grow and prosper.

“巡洋舰”对
招商局的变化感到惊讶

员工精神面貌焕然一新；公司财务取得显著进展；避免浪费，节约精力

作者：CRUISER

有时事情就发生在我们眼皮底下，而我们却视而不见。正如一句老话所说：只见树木，不见森林。

在上海，有多少次新建筑仿佛一夜之间如雨后春笋般涌现。建筑商习惯将这些艺术作品藏在竹篱笆后面，然后突然剥去其外壳，可以说，露出了“光秃秃的手肘”。

现在来看看招商局轮船公司（简称C.M.S.N.）的情况。当“他们”将办公室迁至外滩及拐角的浦东路时，甚至没有竖起竹篱笆。也许这就是我们从未怀疑有任何事情正在发生的原因。

有一天，外滩正门出现的一扇新旋转门只引起了我们一半的好奇心。由于那天我们赶时间，直到几天后才出现调查这一现象的机会。终于有一天，我们有了更多的空闲时间。我们也注意到外面的窗户有些不同。原因就像下棋一样，一旦你立即产生怀疑且不再多言，我们便走了进去。

我们感到惊讶。

鼻子破损的老人

你看，在过去，我们倾向于把招商局办公室看作一个鼻子破损的人。它看起来仿佛经历了人生的所有战役和世间的一切，因为它似乎幸存了下来。事实上，我们曾打赌，我是经理的私人秘书。他忙于无所事事，以至于找不到时间做任何事。

那是很久以前的事了。现在一切似乎都在嗡嗡作响地运转。我走进金先生（Mr. King）的办公室。代理人、经理和商人络绎不绝地涌入。职员们拿着特别指令匆匆进出。电话铃声不断，下达指令的语气干脆利落。几乎没有争论或闲聊。电话另一端的人被告知：“立刻把这艘船调回来……没必要让它在那边多待一天烧煤。”这是我无意中听到的典型对话。这里有行动和喧闹，但没有混乱。

在航运部经理金通贤（T. K. King）这样能干的人的支持下，总经理蔡增基（J. K. Choy）在这家历史悠久且受欢迎的中国轮船公司的组织和行政管理方面创造了奇迹。

以下是已完成工作的一个例子：

9月份的月度吨位货运和客运收入增至11,110.83美元，比去年同期增长15%。

据说7月和8月与1935年同期相比增长了11%。

随着船舶运营效率的恢复和浪费的避免，招商局轮船公司现在开始盈利。这与过去公司亏损的情况形成了巨大变化。

管理层还引入了一套新的会计制度，事实证明非常有效。这使得公司能够更严格地控制支出，并消除不必要的成本。

员工队伍也进行了整顿。那些“鼻子破损的老人”已被渴望学习和努力工作的年轻充满活力的人所取代。这导致公司效率大幅提高。

招商局轮船公司现在期待着光明的未来。随着新员工精神面貌的渗透和公司财务取得的显著进展，毫无疑问，公司将继续成长和繁荣。

李侯爵刑期获减

八个月徒刑
缓刑两年；并须

据《中国晚报》报道，招商局前总经理李国杰侯爵三年前被南市地方法院判处一年两个月监禁，但尚未开始服刑。经向南京最高法院上诉后，其刑期已减为八个月监禁，缓刑两年。

除八个月徒刑外，李侯爵还被责令归还70万美元。据称，这笔款项是他支付给该公司当时的政府督办，以换取后者批准将公司包括码头在内的一些贵重资产抵押给中国地产公司（China Realty Company），抵押金额高达八位数。

据报道，最高法院还命令李侯爵支付这70万美元的利息，这将使应付总额增加到100万美元以上。如果被告无法筹集这笔资金，其财产将被没收。

自原判下达以来，李侯爵一直以患病为由，在大上海医院受到严密看守。据报道，他欠该医院医疗费4,000多美元。

November 1, 1934. Afternoon translation.

China Times and other local newspapers.

THE CASE OF CHINA MERCHANTS STEAM NAVIGATION
COMPANY MANAGER TO BE RE-TRIED

Li Kuo Chieh, former General Manager of the
China Merchants Steam Navigation Company was sentenced
some time ago to three years and six months' imprison-
ment on a charge of embezzlement and neglect of duty.
He later filed an appeal with the Supreme Court against
this sentence.

It is reported that the Supreme Court has
ordered a re-trial of his case. The Kiangsu High
Court will despatch judges to Shanghai to hear the
case in a few days' time. The Central Government will
also detail representatives to watch how the case
proceeds because of its importance.

The former General Manager is still detained in the Shanghai
Public Hospital at Nantao.
